name: @zungun/cloudflare-pilot-v0
description: D1-backed authenticated ZEP message storage, acknowledgements and SyncBurst v0.

scripts.test:unit: npm run clean && npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.fuzz: npm run clean && npm run build && node tools/fuzz-pilot.mjs
scripts.fuzz:sync: npm run clean && npm run build && node tools/fuzz-sync.mjs
scripts.dry-run: rm -rf dist-worker .wrangler && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker --metafile dist-worker/bundle-meta.json --x-provision=false --x-auto-create=false
